applicabilityBasis.summary: HCHF is offered as a Swiss-franc-pegged stablecoin, but its immutable, governance-free protocol exchanges burned HCHF for HBAR collateral, not issuer fiat redemption. The developer disclaims operation, transaction control and any holder claim against a person or entity. Payment-stablecoin applicability is therefore genuinely uncertain.

genius.notes: HCHF is not Swiss national currency merely because it targets CHF. Swisscoast AG is identified as the software developer, not established as a legally obligated payment-stablecoin issuer; issuerEntity is intentionally omitted. Public documentation describes technical collateral redemption rather than a contractual fixed-monetary-value repayment obligation. No token-specific GENIUS authorization, official filing or foreign exception was located; pre-effective GENIUS timing is not a finding of unlawful U.S. distribution.
